sF.text: ONE CANVAS (11-25). Every board here is the current version; older versions and pages were removed. Approved: the shell, the ledger, the survey sheet, Atlas home, the region, the emblem, the Library, the explainer + storyboard, the Gazetteer sample. Awaiting the owner’s look: the market, the opening sheet, the field card ⇄ ATS card, Your survey, the three maps. Retired: v1’s first lesson draft, the ‘How the drafts come into Atlas’ board, the Webhooks place (rejected: it doesn’t follow the plate system), the book-spine stacks (courses / pathways became routes). All data is example data; the person is Maya Chen (fictional).
